title: Male Pattern Hair Loss
subtitle: What male pattern hair loss is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports the hormonal and genetic basis of male pattern hair loss, and the efficacy of primary treatments minoxidil and finasteride. Emerging evidence exists for adjunct therapies such as PRP and laser treatment, though these require further clinical validation. Lifestyle factors have moderate supporting evidence but are not primary treatments.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
